persona: busy returning parent ordering for twins
messages: Hi Sophie, this is Paul. I am a returning parent and I need a big order for my twins for Friday delivery.
Friday delivery please. Address is Building 12, 3rd floor, near ABC Achrafieh, Beirut. Please label half Twin A and half Twin B. Ring once because babies may be sleeping.
